note: Prebuilt/native inputs the APK links against with no source in the repository (K-16). build-apk.sh refuses a mismatch: a fresh clone cannot reproduce the audited APK without these exact bytes. Update deliberately (and re-record the release evidence) after an intentional SDL/Termux upgrade.

third_party/sdl3-android-build/libSDL3.s.provider: SDL3 3.5.0 prebuilt for Android arm64 (donor commit 4ca1b1c per apps/android-native/src/lib.rs)

third_party/vulkan-loader/libvulkan.so.provider: Khronos Vulkan loader for Android arm64 (fallback when target/release/libturnip_vendor.so is absent)

apps/android/debug.keystore.provider: debug signing key generated once (alias androiddebugkey). A fresh clone generates a different key, so the signed APK is not byte-reproducible without this exact keystore.

$PREFIX/lib/libiconv.so.provider: Termux libiconv (SDL3 dependency, copied into the APK)

$PREFIX/lib/libc++_shared.so.provider: Termux libc++_shared (SDL3 dependency, copied into the APK)

target/release/libturnip_vendor.so.provider: Optional Turnip shim built from crates/wc3-vulkan-loader when present; when set, build-apk.sh prefers it over third_party/vulkan-loader/libvulkan.so and verifies this hash.
